description: This Java class defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying internal share links in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages binding data to UI components related to sharing files or folders.

classes.name: InternalShareViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying internal share links, handling UI binding and user interactions.

methods.name: InternalShareViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with a view.

methods.name: InternalShareViewHolder(ItemInternalShareLinkBinding binding, Context context)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with binding and context, setting up the view hierarchy.

methods.name: bind(OCShare share, ShareeListAdapterListener listener)
methods.description: Binds share data to UI components, setting text based on whether the share is a folder or file, and sets click listener for copying the link.
